name: Half-Ogre
traits: Large Giant with +6 Strength, −2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, −2 Intelligence, and −2 Charisma.
Base land speed 30 ft. Darkvision reaches 60 ft. and sees in black and white. +4 natural armor.
The Giant type supplies low-light vision and simple and martial weapon proficiency.
Large size gives −1 to AC and attacks. A Half-Ogre occupies a 10-ft. space and has 10-ft. natural reach.
Common and Giant are automatic. Bonus languages are Abyssal, Draconic, Gnoll, Goblin, and Orc.
Favored class Barbarian. Level adjustment +2. The playable entry grants no racial Hit Dice. One class level is effective character level 3.
